Table

Source: R/table.R
TableClass.Rd

Displays a table: entries made with element_to_mobject (by default Paragraph()) arranged in a grid, with optional row and column labels and lines between the cells. MathTable(), MobjectTable(), IntegerTable() and DecimalTable() use MathTex(), the given mobjects, Integer() and DecimalNumber() as entries.

Positions pos = c(row, col) are 1 based with c(1, 1) the top left entry. Methods: get_rows(), get_columns(), get_entries(pos), get_entries_without_labels(pos), get_row_labels(), get_col_labels(), get_labels(), get_horizontal_lines(), get_vertical_lines(), set_row_colors(...), set_column_colors(...), get_cell(pos, ...), get_highlighted_cell(pos, color, ...), add_highlighted_cell(pos, color, ...), add_background_to_entries() and create(...), an animation drawing the table.

Usage

Table(
  table,
  row_labels = NULL,
  col_labels = NULL,
  top_left_entry = NULL,
  v_buff = 0.8,
  h_buff = 1.3,
  include_outer_lines = FALSE,
  include_inner_lines = TRUE,
  add_background_rectangles_to_entries = FALSE,
  entries_background_color = BLACK,
  include_background_rectangle = FALSE,
  background_rectangle_color = BLACK,
  element_to_mobject = Paragraph,
  element_to_mobject_config = list(),
  arrange_in_grid_config = list(),
  line_config = list(),
  ...
)

MathTable(table, element_to_mobject = MathTex, ...)

MobjectTable(table, element_to_mobject = function(m) m, ...)

IntegerTable(table, element_to_mobject = Integer, ...)

DecimalTable(
  table,
  element_to_mobject = DecimalNumber,
  element_to_mobject_config = list(num_decimal_places = 1),
  ...
)

Arguments

table

An R matrix, a data frame, or a list of rows (vectors or lists) of equal length.

row_labels, col_labels

Lists of mobjects labeling the rows and columns.

top_left_entry

Mobject in the top left corner (needs both kinds of labels).

v_buff, h_buff

Vertical and horizontal buffer between cells.

include_outer_lines

Draw the outer border.

include_inner_lines

Draw the lines between cells.

add_background_rectangles_to_entries

Add a background rectangle to each entry.

entries_background_color

Color of those rectangles.

include_background_rectangle

Add a background rectangle to the table.

background_rectangle_color

Color of that rectangle.

element_to_mobject

Constructor applied to each entry.

element_to_mobject_config

Named list of extra arguments for it.

arrange_in_grid_config

Named list passed to arrange_in_grid().

line_config

Named list passed to Line() for the table lines.

...

Passed to VGroup().

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

t <- Table(list(c("This", "is a"), c("simple", "Table in \n Manim.")))
t$add_highlighted_cell(c(2, 2), color = GREEN)
